question: When is supreme accomplishment quick and when delayed?
premises: Supreme accomplishment is quickly in our views.
Somewhere it is by truth-series-yoga order.
There it is after long time.
inference: Supreme accomplishment is quick in our views, but elsewhere by truth-series-yoga order it comes after long time.
plain_english: Supreme accomplishment is indeed quick, as in our views; but somewhere, by the order of truth-series yoga, it comes only after long time.
